identity.replacementRule: A newer same-position descriptor immediately closes the old epoch; no value may fall back to the prior monster while the new name snapshot is pending.
identity.pkAndFriendlyRule: Never decode friendly actors or enemy PK-player branches as ordinary monster identities.

primaryAttributePromotion.controlledCalibration: At least three distinct known player/pet PK profiles for primary attributes, current/maximum MP, and all five element values; four one-variable vectors are preferred.
primaryAttributePromotion.directRepresentation: Exact scalar agreement in the 0xE00 actor snapshot is necessary but not sufficient.
primaryAttributePromotion.consumerProof: The same field must be observed while an exact-build battle consumer reads the actor object.
primaryAttributePromotion.monsterTransfer: The proven field offset and consumer instruction must both recur on a named ordinary-monster actor.
primaryAttributePromotion.officialReplication: Repeat the same mapping on the official service before marking an attribute exact.
primaryAttributePromotion.absenceMeaning: No scalar match proves only that the raw primary attribute is absent from the captured battle actor, not from the server.
